scope: Full actual written root draft audit; research on constructive hermitian arithmetic remains separate

statements.C:NoetherDeuring_rational: PASS. Read actual root draft. Finite coaction coefficients span a finite coalgebra; its dual supplies the exact finite-dimensional algebra category. Hom is a finite linear kernel and commutes with field extension. A nonzero determinant polynomial has a nonzero value on an (n+1)-element grid over an infinite field. Opened Webb author PDF Thm9.2.8 p144 for arbitrary fields; independently verified the finite-algebraic alternative by forgetting scalars and Krull-Schmidt power cancellation.
statements.C:perfect_Galois_indices: PASS. Canonicalization after coefficient Galois action gives a genuine action despite arbitrary eigenvalue order, with finite orbits. Perfectness makes the division center separable; opened Stacks0753 splits each central-simple factor. Nilpotent radical base change has semisimple quotient and is exactly the new radical. Product matrix sizes are geometric multiplicities and embeddings give one orbit. Restriction of scalars has the whole orbit as support; cross-powers plus Noether-Deuring and KS yield uniqueness. Primitive-idempotent construction uses one explicit finite End algebra. Minimal coefficient degree is preserved by Galois action and faithfully flat field extension.
statements.C:perfect_Green_image: PASS. Distinct orbit-support basis vectors prove injective split-Green extension and exact image; actual tensor and exterior powers commute with scalar extension, so coefficient division by the output Schur index is integral. Finite support, virtual series and dual Schur-index invariance check. This is not asserted to compute arbitrary hermitian multiplicity classes or central-division splitting; the arithmetic boundary is retained.
